name: Singaporean Trains
author: YellowAquarium
description:
# Subway Builder Singaporean Trains

Subway Builder Singaporean Trains is a mod for Subway Builder that adds trains from Singapore's rail network, covering every MRT and LRT generation, the Changi Airport Skytrain, the Sentosa Express monorail and the Johor Bahru-Singapore RTS Link.

## Track Types

This mod uses a proprietary track and train separation system that allows every compatible train to run on every compatible track, making track type management easy when building recreations of existing systems. Each line has its own track type, named `{gauge}{line code}-{speed}`. The rubber-tyred LRT and Skytrain lines use `AGT` in place of the gauge, and the Sentosa Express monorail uses `MON`.
Initial builds should be done with a track option where applicable. Compatible tracks are listed at the end of the train name, e.g. both SG C151 NSEWL 1435NS and SG R151 NSEWL 1435NS are compatible with 1435NS-80 tracks. Specific trains can be chosen afterwards in the route menu.

For further details on specific train stats, please refer to the [README on GitHub](https://github.com/YellowAquarium/singaporean-trains).
